title: Checking User Dispute History (Internal)
summary: Use the get_user_dispute_history_7291 tool to retrieve a specific user’s credit card dispute history by required input user_id. It returns a list of disputes with dispute_id, dispute_date, status, last_updated_at, and transaction details (transaction_id/date, merchant_name, amount/currency, card_last4) plus reason_code/outcome/notes when available.
